newsitem.title: USA: Princeton Media sets one-for-20 split.
newsitem.headline: Princeton Media sets one-for-20 split.

text.p: Princeton Media Group Inc, which will became the new name of DeNovo Corp at the close of business on Monday, said it will complete a one-for-twenty reverse split of its common stock.
Prior to the split, the company said it had about 30 million outstanding shares on a fully-diluted basis.
The reverse split will reduce this number to about 1.5 million shares, the company said.
One whole share will be issued in lieu of any fractional share, the company said.

At the opening of business on Tuesday, the price of Princeton Media Group's stock will be adjusted to reflect the split, which will affect all of the company's 1,200 common stockholders, the company said.
The name is being changed to reflect the new focus of the corporation on its niche in the publishing, printing and media industries, the company said.
